title: Trump suggests renaming New Mexico amid torrent of online memes and taunts
description: The suggestion came as the president unleashed dozens of social media posts. He lacks authority to rename New Mexico or any other state.

title: Democrats try a novel path to defeat a battleground Republican: Moving to the left
description: Antiestablishment candidate Randy Villegas is testing the conventional wisdom about what it would take to unseat Rep. David G. Valadao in California.

title: Trump pledged to lower prices in eight areas. Have they risen or fallen?
description: Test your knowledge and see which campaign promises the president has achieved.

title: With the midterms fast approaching, campaign season begins
description: Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season as Republicans work to maintain control of the House and the Senate amid President Trump's unpopular second term.

title: What to expect as midterm campaign season kicks off
description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with Charlie Cook, founder of the nonpartisan Cook Political Report, about the outlook for Democrats and Republicans as midterm campaign season kicks off.

title: Armed individual ‘lunged’ at Democratic nominee for Ohio governor, campaign says
description: Amy Acton’s campaign said multiple people were injured at the event at a county fair in Canfield, Ohio.

title: Trump appeals to Supreme Court as time runs out on push to restrict mail voting
description: With November midterms approaching, two swing states are sending ballots, and other states plan to send theirs soon.

title: Inside Pirro’s special grand jury probe into D.C. agencies supervising kids
description: The investigation appears focused on whether officials are adequately supervising children in and out of school, with scrutiny on attendance and social worker visits.

title: These are the most important House races to watch in November
description: Democrats are favored to win the House, but Republicans have viable paths to keeping control. These are the key themes and races to keep an eye on.

title: Public backlash against data centers is rising. Politicians are playing catchup
description: Public sentiment against data centers is running high this election season, leaving politicians of all stripes scrambling to respond. We look at how this is playing out in Pennsylvania.

title: Politics chat: First-ever Republican midterm convention or Trump rally?
description: A first-ever Republican midterm convention is taking place this week in Dallas, but are candidates interested in attending? Plus, Michigan's Democratic senate candidate apologizes to Jewish voters.

title: Witkoff and Kushner call Kyiv talks 'substantive' after Moscow Putin meeting
description: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held meetings in Kyiv with Ukraine's President Zelenskyy on Sunday, a day after lengthy conversations with Russian President Putin in Moscow.

title: Trump removes White House shrouds as he prepares for Xi visit
description: The president had ordered repairs to the iconic, and Ionic, columns outside the White House entrance.

title: Trump begins major midterm spending with $10 million ad buy in Texas
description: Republicans, nervous about the tight Senate race in the Lone Star state, hope Trump’s political war chest can boost GOP nominee Ken Paxton.

title: Trump administration to dig at triumphal arch site despite no final federal approvals
description: The Trump administration says it will break ground on a 250-foot triumphal arch in Washington, D.C., without final federal approval and despite an ongoing lawsuit.

title: Week in Politics: Trump's face on the coin; reshaping the capital; the midterms
description: President Trump is the first living president to have his face on a coin. He's also reshaping Washington in his image, and working to influence midterm elections.

title: Voters are fed up with data centers. Both parties are trying to cash in for midterms
description: Democrats and Republicans have found common ground in this campaign season. Both parties have poured millions into ads attacking data centers as the public continues to protest the AI facilities.

title: Flock cameras draw opposition from across the political spectrum
description: As political races heat up heading into the midterms, candidates from both parties are increasingly joining the fray to voice concerns over Flock surveillance cameras.

title: 4 things investigators learned about the dysfunction at Trump's Labor Department
description: A report from Labor Department investigators found former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer violated her own department's policy prohibiting harassment. She resigned in April.
